name: Weekly Cleaning Schedule
description: Creates a room-by-room weekly cleaning plan customized to household size, available time, and home layout. Includes task-by-task checklists with time estimates per room, daily touch-up routines, and efficiency strategies for busy schedules. Use when the user asks about cleaning routines, weekly cleaning plans, how long cleaning should take, or maintaining a clean home with limited time. Do NOT use for deep cleaning or seasonal cleaning (use deep-cleaning-checklist), move-in/move-out cleaning (use move-cleaning), or commercial cleaning schedules.
